svg.title: Nine-zone warehouse scenario
svg.desc: Nine connected warehouse zones with 3 robots per zone. Four two-way corners, four T junctions, and one four-way crossing are joined by three-cell aisles. Each robot picks up locally, delivers to another zone, then parks in its private dropoff bay.

g.text: 27 robots · 3 m aisles · local pickup → cross-zone delivery · private bays
Each row and column has the same total.
Filled circle: robot start and ID
P: pickup bay · D: dropoff / final parking
Colors identify the robot's starting zone.
Amber outline: active outer slow rectangle
Map cells are 1 m. Junction degree counts connected aisles; bay spurs are task stations.
